items.title: Why is Speculative Decoding Fast? (4 minute read)

It enables the ability to look at many tokens at once and accept the ones that would have been generated by the big model. items.title: Quicksand (GitHub Repo)
items.snippet: Quicksand is an async Python API for launching, controlling, and snapshotting QEMU virtual machines with a particular focus on sandboxing AI agents. It provides pre-built Linux VMs for Ubuntu and Alpine distros. Quicksand supports x86_64 and ARM64 across macOS, Linux, and Windows. The sandboxes do not need root privileges or Docker.
